programs.description: Antony Firingee, of Portuguese descent, pursues his dream of becoming a celebrated Bengali folk poet. However, his ardent love for a courtesan named Shakila ultimately leads him to a tragic demise.
Narsingh, a taxi driver, decides to return to his native place, but finds himself involved with a businessman en route, who is also a smuggler and human trafficker.
Nira falls in love with Binu, an artist, but their relationship suffers a heavy blow when Protima gets jealous of their bond and plots to separate them.
When the employees of an advertising agency start getting killed one after another, detective Prabhat is tasked with finding the person responsible for the murders.
Samita rescues Parul, a village girl, from the clutches of human trafficking with the help of Surajit, a journalist. She tries to find a shelter for Parul while struggling with her own problems.
Tapasi is an educated young girl who was married off when she was a child. However, her life takes a dramatic turn when she grows up and falls in love with Kiriti.
